heading: Publication

calibration.note: Same one-paper profile (14 proofs of arXiv 0708.2185); no new measurement was made for this problem. The rules are restated for a direct proof with two cited results.

rules.rule: No sentence may be commentary only (placement inflight or leaf-section). A reason for a step may appear only as a clause of the sentence that takes the step.
No restatement of the claim before the derivation; the proof opens with its first step.

Each cited result (exponent monotonicity on a probability space; the lower estimate of an L^n quantity by a bound on a set) is invoked in one sentence that says what it consumes; hypotheses are not checked in separate sentences unless the check is an argument the reader cannot be expected to supply. The positive measure of the level set is such an argument and is kept.
At most 168 words; aim for 120 or fewer.
Every mandatory node of the content plan is realized or merged with an honest quote; every dependency between nodes in the alignment is still visible in the prose.
